name: hbm_sfu_programme_store_r13_cls

pin_regs.reason: the r11 head registers every host input at the pin (p_* pin flops, 2-flop reset sync) and every output is a relay-fed pin register (o_io / o_ctl / status pad); a kit flop stage would add an unpriced edge (the r11 relays are priced in the RTL header: D=10, status 8)

structural_change: r13 (HBM-SFUPS8 10-20, after r12_clg --cts gate FAIL clock_rule TT/FF pin-flop spread 136.0/143.8 ps with trial GRT overflow 0, native32 max 18): the count-bisection spine (default) over 1080x950 um with 14.9k sinks started at iter-0 leaf spread 918 ps and was flattened to 28 ps only by 33.7k leaf PAD cells (cell delay) that do not track the wire-dominated trunk across corners/RC (clock_spine.tcl SYM note: smh r10 28.8 TT -> 102 FF; here measured SS/TT/FF boundary spread 101/136/144). Structural clock change: OT_SPINE_SYM=1 = bisection tree with nodes at the CENTRE of the leaves' bounding box (equal trunk per branch: balance by geometry, not pads), child leaves (r10n2 store leaves, 243.9 ps own insertion) tap the tree at their earliest-needed node. RTL, relays, floorplan, pins identical to r12_clg (faaef83bb, D=10/status 8). FALLBACK: symmetric bbox-centred spine (OT_SPINE_SYM=1) + leaf pads + safe balance | r12 (HBM-SU6/SFUPS12 10-20, after r11_cl/r11_clm TERMINAL GPL-0305): RTL = Codex faaef83bb (status-ordinal reset published by 4 kept same-edge rb_word copies, 16 loads each; native32 PASS max 18 over 22,039 roots; capture/output edges unchanged, D=10 / status 8). Relay geometry: every FIRM relay flop is swapped to the widest family master (DFFHQNx3, 1.188 um) BEFORE anchor_row_packing, so the timing-driven GPL resizer can only keep or shrink it -- the r11 failure mode (1,456 FIRM x1 flops grown to x2/x3 after legal x1 packing -> 97 fixed-cell overlaps -> invalid gradient step) cannot occur by construction. rb_word copies stay movable (placed by GPL beside their 16 status loads). VARIANT clg: GPL routability-driven inflation off -- r11 GPL inflated the 924 um2 of movable cells by +1,475% (13.6k um2) against RUDY of the FIXED relay buses (99% of std cells are FIRM relays / pin flops), overflow stuck 0.6-0.7 for 7k iterations; congestion is judged by the gate trial GRT instead. | r11 (HBM-ELEMOWN3/SFUPS 10-19) after the r10 cluster --cts gate FAIL (ref_gate/hbm_sfu_programme_store_r10_cl-20261018-180939: post-GRT repair_timing stuck at SS WNS -256 ps on pr_base[0][4]/D, 468 endpoints; the single per-row launch relay spanned ~1.5 mm from the E-face start pins to three leaves 830 um apart). Same 11 closed r10n2 leaves, same 1080 x 950.4 outline / leaf positions / pin faces; the head is redesigned as FORWARDED MULTI-STAGE RELAYS sized from the floorplan, one kept copy per destination (reset KR=3, IO launch KI=2, programme launch KL=4, config chain heads P0 1 / P3 3 / P6 4 / IO0 2, per-leaf write strobes depth(l), per-leaf status KS=2 + 2 pads, outputs KO=4), every stage placed FIRM at its channel point by relay_place.tcl (relay_place_gen.py; longest register-to-register leg 382 um <= 405 reach; 11,843 relay flops). All leaves of a calendar stay in lockstep (equal launch depth), every head function is computed at its consuming site with an equal-depth reset copy. Priced: D 5 -> 10, status 3 -> 8, arith_start advance 2 -> 5, first write 7 edges after reset.

job.purpose: SFU programme store r13_cls: r12_clg + FALLBACK: symmetric bbox-centred spine (OT_SPINE_SYM=1) + leaf pads + safe balance. CRITICAL hbm_sfu_programme_store: coordinator reviews gate PNG before submit. SFU programme store r12_clg: Codex faaef83bb reset-bounded RTL + presized FIRM relays + GPL routability off. CRITICAL: coordinator review only. SFU programme store r11 parent cluster: r10 leaves + floorplan-sized forwarded multi-stage relays (reach <= 405 um, lockstep launch, D=10, status 8). CRITICAL (hbm_sfu_programme_store): coordinator reviews the gate PNG before submit. Replaces hbm_sfu_programme_store_r10_cl (gate FAIL 10-18).
